_readme: SAP Customer Loyalty Management pack knowledge. Target-only SaaS: no unit lists, no deprecation regexes (nothing to scan).

target_api_endpoint_families: the four REST APIs of the Business Accelerator Hub package plus the few paths the help portal documents verbatim. Operation-level paths of the four APIs are NOT listed - the OpenAPI specifications need an SAP login and were not read; take them from api.sap.com before quoting.
target_content_component_types: CLM ships no CMS and no member UI; the list names the CLM objects that carry member-visible content and then the member-facing components a project builds itself.

target_capability_map status values: standard = documented feature usable as is; config = documented, needs configuration in the admin UI; integration = documented capability that needs a custom integration from the source system; custom = not documented, must be built outside CLM or is a gap. Every row cites the reference-cache section that verifies it.
target_api_endpoint_families: Checkout Connect (REST, 1.0.0-beta): retrieve available promotions and discount codes during checkout, settle offer redemptions in the transaction, submit basket details for post-sales loyalty processing - the documented earn/burn path for POS and eCommerce
Wallet Connect (REST, 1.0.0-beta): wallets and identity, clubs, benefits, cards - for digital channels, marketing automation and customer service
Backend Services (REST, 1.0.0-beta): wallet processes, card adjustments, club management, engagement triggers - for decisioning, data and operational systems
Data Products (REST, 1.0.0-beta): master data import, resource access, transaction processing

Data Products transaction exports: GET /admin/dataproducts/v1/workspaces/{workspaceId}/exports/runs/{runId}, POST .../exports/runs/{runId}/download, GET .../exports/jobs/{jobId}/runs/latest (compressed CSV + JSON manifest, SAP-managed storage)
Wallet deletion: DELETE /workspaces/{workspaceId}/wallets/{walletId} (customer-run deletion after retention; CLM deletes no personal data itself)

S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition master data replication (inbound, DRF over RFC destination): /central/v1/sap/products/replication (CIC_PROD), /central/v1/sap/retailProductRegularSalesPrices/replication (CIC_SLSPRC), /central/v1/sap/plants/replication (CIC_PLANT), /central/v1/sap/merchandiseCategoryHierarchyNodes/replication (CIC_MCH)

Authentication: OAuth 2.0 client credentials via SAP Cloud Identity Services app-to-app (consumer application under the clm-sci-instance parent, dependency public_api); machine-to-machine only, HTTPS 443
Events / webhooks: none documented (the Business Accelerator Hub product has one content package with REST APIs only) *(verify)*
target_content_component_types: NO CMS and NO member-facing UI shipped - CLM's UI is an administration application for business users, specialists and service agents
CLM object with member-visible content: reward / point exchange offer (name, media asset, description, points, issuer) in the regional rewards bank
CLM object with member-visible content: promotion (discount, points offer, personal discount code) and journey (call to action, media asset)
CLM object with member-visible content: club and brand (name, logo), communication topics for opt-in
custom storefront component: enrolment and consent capture (terms of service, privacy) bound to the wallet
custom storefront component: points balance (current, available, pending), tier status and history
custom storefront component: rewards catalogue and redemption (point exchange to discount code)
custom storefront component: offers in the wallet and code application at checkout
custom storefront component: pay with points in checkout (minimum and block rules)
custom storefront component: group wallet management (only if group pooling is used)
service channel: SAP Service Cloud V2 HTML mashup of the CLM wallet lookup (documented)

target_capability_map.capability: Loyalty program, one main membership club per workspace, every customer a member
Additional clubs with own points/tier program (earn only, no spend)
Multi-brand: loyalty program owner, member brands (sales organisation id), partner brands (business partner id), booking and redemption rates
Points earning: base earn rate per currency unit of the member brand, rounding incl. fractions
Points earning from orders: basket submission from POS/eCommerce through Checkout Connect
Points earning from ERP invoices / deliveries / distributor sell-through data
Pending points via 'Postponed' spending (fixed number of days, main program only)
Points expiry (monthly after N months, or never)
Returns / cancellations / credit notes reversing earned points
Earning, spending, gifting and goodwill limits
Goodwill points (add in UI, remove via API)
Point transfer between members (API, atomic validation)
Pay with points at checkout (main program, minimum and blocks)
Tiers with status points; evaluation by thresholds and periodic staff evaluation; status points from journeys
Automatic tier qualification / requalification periods
Rewards bank per region, rewards issued as discount codes, tier-specific point prices
Physical premium catalogue with fulfilment
Promotions with approval, budget, funding, targeting by individual, segment or tier
Personal discount codes with workspace code formats
Journeys (brand and partner interactions, bonus or tier status points)
Customer segments (bulk ingestion from a data platform or manual)
Consent and communication preference tracking (texts and messaging outside CLM)
Customer communication (email, SMS, push)
Group wallet pooling points of persons (one group per member)
Company / account-level wallet, organisation hierarchy, purchaser vs beneficiary
Receipt / purchase claim upload and validation
Append-only double-entry ledger with book types, liabilities dashboard, transaction exports (CSV, daily or manual)
Financial posting / accruals into SAP S/4HANA
Master data from SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition (products, prices, plants, product groups)
Service agent wallet view in SAP Service Cloud V2 (mashup)
SAP Commerce Cloud / composable storefront integration and member UI
SAP Customer Data Cloud identity linkage, SAP Customer Data Platform, SAP Emarsys integration
Analytics share to SAP Business Data Cloud

target_documented_integrations: SAP S/4HANA Cloud Private Edition -> CLM: master data only (products, regular sales prices, plants as stores, merchandise category hierarchy as product groups); DRF replication over an HTTP RFC destination with OAuth profile CIC_OAUTH_PROFILE; accepted with HTTP 202, ingested on a system-controlled schedule, invalid records excluded
SAP Service Cloud Version 2: HTML mashup of the CLM wallet lookup; agents need the CLM role Service Agent and registration in the CLM identity authentication service
SAP Business Data Cloud: transaction data can be shared for analytics (no setup documented) *(verify)*

NOT documented (2026-10-05): SAP Commerce Cloud, composable storefront, SAP Customer Data Cloud, SAP Customer Data Platform, SAP Emarsys, SAP Integration Suite content, financial posting into SAP S/4HANA
target_limits: two workspaces per subscription; consumption metered across workspaces
one wallet per customer per workspace; a member belongs to at most one group wallet and owns at most one
personal discount code length 20-30 characters, prefix and suffix at most 4 characters, format not editable after save
workspace name 2-50 characters; workspace image up to 5 MB; brand and club logos below 2 MB
export download URLs expire after 60 seconds by default
API rate limits, payload limits and wallet volumes: not published *(verify)*
